claim: Opt-in UI-script screenshots now move PNG encoding and atomic publication off the GUI hook. A bounded, ProtoInput-DLL-free, virtual-seat GUI run clicked Keyboard Compatibility and Native controls, obtained a complete app-owned 540x520 PNG whose request-time modification timestamp followed the Native controls event, returned Home, and closed normally.
validation: The required Rust format, strict Clippy, workspace tests (456 passed, 0 failed, 3 ignored), and x64/i686 builds passed. Four capture worker tests cover latest-frame coalescing, nonjoining Drop, failure recovery, prior-PNG retention, and stale request-time freshness. The single owned native run recorded six actual control events and six sample acknowledgments, with no surviving staged process.
limits: Historical native-controls attempt004 remains OPEN/P1; its cause and fix are unproven. Other GUI telemetry writes and renderer behavior are outside this change. This run makes no physical-input, RustDesk, desktop-wide, same-process, backend-injection, or full Ultra-parity claim.
